claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and appropriate PEEP.
Wean FiO2 from 80-100% as tolerated while maintaining SpO2 ≥90-92%, given persistent severe hypoxemia and elevated A-a gradient.
Reassess sedation target (goal RASS 0 to -1) and titrate propofol/fentanyl infusions to facilitate ventilator weaning and neurologic assessment.
Continue broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy (vancomycin, cefepime, voriconazole, acyclovir) and reassess daily for de-escalation based on cultures and clinical course.
Monitor platelet count (49-51 K/uL) and coagulation parameters (INR 1.6, PT 17.4 s) with repeat CBC/coagulation in 24 hours; assess bleeding risk before procedures.
Monitor blood counts for leukemic response to cytarabine/fludarabine/hydroxyurea therapy; repeat CBC with differential.
Replete electrolytes: potassium 3.4 mEq/L and ionized calcium 1.09 mmol/L; continue replacement and recheck levels.
Monitor blood pressure closely (recent MAP 49-57 mmHg) and titrate norepinephrine infusion to maintain adequate perfusion.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with pantoprazole and bowel regimen given ICU status and opioid use.
Maintain fall and pressure injury precautions (Braden very poor nutrition, bedfast) with repositioning and nutrition assessment.
